title: Main Street Lexington Triangle
summary: A planted traffic island at the north end of Lexington's Main Street, its low stone walls lettered with the town's name.
reviewNote: Existing text from the current site. "Northend" was corrected to "north end". The client, the year and the four-part story are still to come.
description: Design for traffic triangle at the north end of Lexington's Main Street.

photos.alt: Planted traffic island with a low stone wall lettered LEXINGTON, yellow flowers in front and a church spire beyond
Curved stone wall carved with the word LEXINGTON, tulips above it and yellow flowers below
The planted triangle between two streets, with a blue one-story building behind it
Brick-paved center of the triangle ringed by stone planters of tulips, with a bus passing behind
The triangle seen from above, with yellow planting beds, clipped hedges and the intersection around it
